== Lightning Mode

- When Lightning Mode fails to start, the error message now names the likely cause when Kobiton can identify it, for example when the video server does not respond. When the cause is unknown, the message still ends with *Network Error*.
- Fixed an issue where *Latency* was often blank in the Speedometer during Lightning Mode, and *Resolution* stayed blank after turning Lightning Mode off and on.
- Organizations that turn on _Show option to launch device with WebRTC debug panel_ now see a *Diagnostics* switch under *Lightning Mode* in manual sessions. The switch opens the *Lightning Mode Diagnostics* panel, which logs connection details for troubleshooting.

// REVIEWER NOTE: Only the "video server did not respond" message was confirmed in testing.
// The "network may be blocking the connection" message did not appear in the client-side
// UDP-block test (Network Error appeared instead), and the "no video arrived" and DTLS
// messages were not reachable from the UI. The bullet stays general for that reason.
